import statistics
import time
import tracemalloc

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from orders.app import app

client = TestClient(app)


def _call(method, url, body):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    response = client.request(method, url, content=body or None, headers={"content-type": "application/json"})
    return response, (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000


REQUEST = ('GET', '/orders', '')
BUDGET_P50_MS = 24.5  # pre-incident p50 8.17 ms, with margin
BUDGET_P95_MS = 32.2  # pre-incident p95 12.17 ms, with margin


def test_incident_request_stays_within_latency_budget():
    _call(*REQUEST)  # warm-up
    timings = sorted(_call(*REQUEST)[1] for _ in range(20))
    assert statistics.median(timings) <= BUDGET_P50_MS, timings
    assert timings[18] <= BUDGET_P95_MS, timings

import statistics
import time

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from orders.app import app


def test_orders_list_latency_within_healthy_budget():
    baseline_p50_ms = 8.17
    baseline_p95_ms = 12.17
    median_budget_ms = max(3 * baseline_p50_ms, baseline_p50_ms + 10)
    p95_budget_ms = max(2 * baseline_p95_ms, baseline_p95_ms + 20)

    with TestClient(app) as client:
        warmup = client.get("/orders")
        assert (
            warmup.status_code == 200
        ), f"/orders warmup request returned HTTP {warmup.status_code}, expected 200"

        durations_ms = []
        for i in range(20):
            start = time.perf_counter()
            response = client.get("/orders")
            elapsed_ms = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000.0

            assert (
                response.status_code == 200
            ), f"/orders request {i + 1} returned HTTP {response.status_code}, expected 200"
            durations_ms.append(elapsed_ms)

    median_ms = statistics.median(durations_ms)
    p95_ms = statistics.quantiles(durations_ms, n=20, method="inclusive")[18]

    assert (
        median_ms <= median_budget_ms
    ), f"/orders median latency {median_ms:.2f} ms exceeds healthy budget {median_budget_ms:.2f} ms"
    assert (
        p95_ms <= p95_budget_ms
    ), f"/orders p95 latency {p95_ms:.2f} ms exceeds healthy budget {p95_budget_ms:.2f} ms"
